text: "Physics & Romance" is a newly released romance game. Its excellent animation and unexpected storylines have attracted the attention of many people, making it one of the most popular games in recent days.
It is said that more than 100,000 college students were invited to complete surveys for this game when it was being developed, and that all the options are based on real situations and events.
Of course, this isn't my point. The main reason I'm mentioning this is that Sora Ichinose is playing this game in front of me right now.
Sora Ichinose
{character:Sora Ichinose}Hmm, I failed again...
After the words "Game Over" start flashing on the screen, Sora puts down the console and scratches his head in frustration. It's clear that this isn't the first time he got a bad ending.
player
{character:player}I never expected you to be interested in a romance game, Sora. I thought you would like sci-fi games more.
{character:Sora Ichinose}Knowing what's popular in the market gives me more topics to talk about when communicating with other people.
{character:player}Haha, in a way, the fact that "Physics & Romance" has kinda won over your approval has made me a little curious about it.
{character:Sora Ichinose}{var:player_nickname}, you haven't tried this game yet?
Sora raises his head suddenly and looks at me with eyes full of pleasant surprise. I've only seen this look before when he was solving complicated mathematical olympiad problems.
{character:player}Yeah, I've only seen the trailers and some interviews with the dev team. I don't really know any details.
{character:Sora Ichinose}Umm... Would you like to play it together?
{character:player}Eh? But isn't it a single-player game?!
Sora sighs deeply and opens his notebook with some embarrassment. The pages are filled with records of bad endings Sora achieved while playing the game, and there are far more than I ever imagined.

{character:Sora Ichinose}To improve my experience, I investigated many games of the same type before I started playing it. I even did research on the trailers, CG pictures, game guides, and player comments and made a special form for this purpose.
{character:Sora Ichinose}The problem I'm facing now is that... I can't seem to clear the game even though I have so much data.
{character:player}If you want a happy ending, isn't the fastest way to search for guides online?

{character:Sora Ichinose}But then the meaning of "observation and interaction" would be lost... Since there's no problem with the game itself, I can only try to find other ways to clear the game. If you play it, you could provide me with a different data sample.

{character:player}I'm afraid you're the only person in One Han City who would treat a romance game as data analysis. Anyway, the mahjong room is full right now, which means I probably won't get a seat anytime soon, so I guess I might as well play with you for a while.
After hearing my affirmative reply, Sora immediately frees up the seat beside him and motions for me to sit down. Then he eagerly presses the "Start Over" option.
The screen of the console dims before becoming bright again, taking me and Sora into a dark alley where a chubby boy is surrounded by people and is clutching the straps of his schoolbag helplessly.
Delinquent A
{character:Delinquent A}Heh, fatty, who are you trying to avoid by sneaking out through the back door of the school?
Delinquent B
{character:player}Pause! If I remember correctly, isn't "Physics & Romance" set in a university ? What's with these junior high school delinquents?

{character:Sora Ichinose}This is the prologue animation of the game. While he was in elementary school, the protagonist met the heroine by chance when he was being blackmailed by delinquents. After they reunite at their university, the protagonist starts to pursue the heroine. That's what it says in the game description.
As soon as I finish speaking, a girl wearing the same school uniform appears on the screen. She quickly walks inside the encirclement and stands in front of the protagonist like his protector.
{character:???}Stop! I won't let you bully other people!
{character:Delinquent A}Where did this pipsqueak come from? Someone throw her outta here!
{character:???}I've already called the teacher! The teacher is rushing over here now. Those who bully others will have to write a self-criticism note as punishment!
{character:Delinquent B}Hah! Who are you trying to scare? Do you even know how to spell "self-criticism?"
{character:Delinquent A}I think someone really is coming this way. I don't want things to blow up. Darn, what a bummer.
{character:Delinquent B}It's your lucky day! Pipsqueak, I'll remember this! You better pray that you don't run into me again.
{character:Delinquent A}Hey, stop wasting time. We gotta get outta here.

After the delinquents leave, there are suddenly only two people left in the alley. The sky starts to rain at the right time, covering the image with a layer of fog. The little girl turns around and extends an olive branch to the boy.
{character:???}Are you okay? Can you still stand? ... Don't worry, I've scared off the baddies. No one will bully you now. What's your name?
The beautiful scene comes to an abrupt end, and a box appears in the center of the screen: Please enter a character name.

Sora uses the joystick skillfully and moves the cursor to the randomize button next to the box. Recalling his original intention for inviting me to play the game together, I decide to play my role as his helper conscientiously.
{character:player}Sora, don't you want to enter your name?
{character:Sora Ichinose}Huh?

{character:player}Gal games aren't like other games. Entering your own name will make the experience more immersive. If you change how you see this game, maybe you'll be able to find the key to clearing the game.
{character:Sora Ichinose}There's no data to support your theory, but I think your idea's worth a try.

Sora makes "Sora Ichinose" walk back and forth on the screen. I can't help but smile when I see his childish behavior. As if he could read my thoughts, Sora coughs lightly to relieve the embarrassment.
{character:Sora Ichinose}It really does feel like a new experience... Ahem, I was right to ask you to help me.
"Sora Ichinose"
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}I'm... My name is Sora Ichinose.
{character:???}Sora Ichinose? What a lovely name. Don't walk home alone late at night next time. It's very dangerous.
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}You... Are you leaving?
The girl is completely oblivious to how heroic she was just then. She waves her hand lightly and skips as she prepares to leave the alley.
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}Wait...! What's your name?
{character:???}Ryuushi—My name is Ryuushi—

Her voice travels through the air from afar through the pattering of the rain, sounding unreal and like something from a dream. If he wasn't holding the umbrella she gave him, he would've thought that everything that just happened was his own fantasy.
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}Ryuu...shi? Doesn't that sound just like the particles the teacher taught us about in physics class? What a strange name. But... thank you... I think we'll meet again.
Rat-tat-tat—
After the prologue ends, I can hear the sound of Sora's finger tapping the table clearly. He is tilting his head, and confusion fills his blue eyes.
{character:Sora Ichinose}I don't get it.
{character:player}What do you mean?

{character:Sora Ichinose}Why did the heroine step forward to save him alone? According to the character introduction in the game introduction, she is neither a martial arts master nor from a family of Taekwondo experts. Any junior high school student can push her to the ground. Wouldn't the situation be even more dangerous then?!
Although the "dude in distress" trope is quite clichéd, it often symbolizes the beginning of a bond in TV series, novels, and games. The question Sora asked was from an angle I never considered.
After thinking about it for a while, I decide to listen to his thoughts first.
{character:player}What would you do?

{character:Sora Ichinose}Well, if it was me... I would definitely choose a way that can ensure everyone's safety, such as asking others for help. Since the delinquents were junior high school students, a classmate might not be able to provide much practical help. In this situation, it's safer to ask a teacher for help.
After pausing, he elaborates further.
{character:Sora Ichinose}A P.E. teacher would be best.
Listening to Sora's description, my brain draws a specific scene for me by itself.

Surrounded by a crowd, the protagonist is trembling in a corner. Heavy footsteps travel over from the alley at this time, announcing the arrival of a burly P.E. teacher who appears before the crowd and chases away the wicked delinquents.

Facing the teacher who saved him, the protagonist is so moved that he vows to repay the teacher's help by studying hard. Soon after, the protagonist takes home the trophy of the mathematical olympiad, bringing glory to his school.
Eh? Why has the story become so motivational? Isn't this a romance game?!

{character:player}Sora, you're not wrong, but there are moments when people can't be absolutely rational. When this happens, they will step forward without hesitation even if they know what will happen.
{character:Sora Ichinose}*Coughs* Will you also do the same?
{character:player}Of course! Humans are complex and contradictory by nature.

Sora hasn't been able to spend much time with others due to his physical condition, so I completely understand his doubts right now. I wanted to help him understand the heroine's actions through my explanation, but Sora has obviously misunderstood something.
{character:Sora Ichinose}I understand, so {var:player_nickname} likes to interact with others in this way.
{character:player}Not exactly...
The console that has been neglected for a while starts playing brisk background music suddenly, interrupting my explanation and diverting Sora's attention back to the game.
It'll seem too deliberate if I continue explaining that topic now. Forget it, I'll explain it to him again later.
A university campus filled with the exuberant aura of youth appears in front of us. The breeze blows petals into the window of the library, making the sunlight look even softer.

"Sora Ichinose" keeps moving back and forth between the bookshelves. It's rare that the professor didn't arrange any after-class experiment today, so he decided to come to the library to take out an important textbook. As he gets closer and closer to his target, he reaches out excitedly...
However, at the very instant he touches the book, another hand grabs the book's spine. "Sora Ichinose" looks in the direction of the other hand and sees a familiar face.
"Ryuushi"—a familiar name pops up in his mind. Despite the changes to her face, one glance is all he needs to recognize the girl from back then.
"Ryuushi"
{character:"Ryuushi"}Sorry! I didn't see you just then. I didn't do that on purpose.
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}...It's you.
{character:"Ryuushi"}Excuse me? Have we... met before?

The girl on the other side looks over in confusion, totally unaware of the turbulence waving in his heart. Fate is such a marvelous thing—she rescued him in that moonlit alley back then, and now, ten years later, he has reunited with this person who has made a place in his heart in this brightly lit library.
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}The force of attraction related to the product of the distance between any two objects or particles and their masses is called gravity.
{character:"Ryuushi"}What?
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}Oh, it's nothing. I just thought of something suddenly.
{character:"Ryuushi"}Do you also study physics? Haha, what a coincidence! Can I borrow this book first? Please! The monthly exam is next week, and I really need this book.
The game freezes on the girl's cute gesture of putting her hands together, and two options pop up on the screen—"Let her borrow the book" and "Insist on borrowing the book yourself".
Recalling the number of failures recorded in Sora's notebook, I get ready to give him some advice when I see that he has chosen the first of the two options.
On the screen, the girl takes the book and thanks the protagonist gratefully. The game uses an obvious pink arrow to remind us that her feelings for the protagonist have improved.
{character:player}Sora, I think you're actually playing pretty well. Why weren't you able to clear the game even once?
{character:Sora Ichinose}Some parts of the game have been designed unreasonably, so it's normal for there to be some deviations in my calculations.
{character:player}Unreasonable? What do you mean?

{character:Sora Ichinose}According to my investigations on games of the same genre, I have to choose "Let her borrow the book" to continue the story, but this is obviously wrong. Compared with the small amount of Affinity gained, the other option lets you gain 50 Knowledge Points... What a shame.
{character:player}Points? Knowledge Points? What's that?
His words don't make any sense to me, someone who had only watched trailers of this game before, so I can't help interrupting him. He opens the character interface and patiently answers my question.
{character:Sora Ichinose}In addition to height, weight, and other basic information, Physics & Romance also has other stats such as Knowledge, Agility, and Stamina Points.

{character:Sora Ichinose}Each stat plays a different role in the subsequent story. For example, Agility increases the chance that players will trigger special tasks, and Stamina increases the duration of some limited-time tasks.
{character:player}What about the Knowledge Points you just mentioned? What do they do?
{character:player}Is it needed to clear the game?
{character:Sora Ichinose}To be precise, the chance of clearing the game in the subsequent story reaches 80.75%.
The data he calculates is accurate to two decimal places. How strict!
{character:player}Let me see... The character currently has 150 "Knowledge Points." If you got that book... Oh! It's such a pity when I think about it now!
{character:Sora Ichinose}I've already recorded this point. I'll email this feedback to the game developers later. I hope they'll improve this.

This is a commonly used method to increase the interaction between the male and female protagonists in romance games, but... looking at Sora who is carefully making records, I think it will take this child a while to understand this.
After last time's "book-borrowing" incident, "Ryuushi" and "Sora" become acquainted quickly and become good friends.
{character:"Ryuushi"}Ahhhh! Who is it?! I just respawned at the altar—

The girl screams while holding a mobile phone and rolls into a ball angrily on a sofa in the student council's room. On the gray screen, the scene of a character being killed with one hit is replaying.
Recently, other than attending classes and doing experiments, "Ryuushi" has been practicing hard on her mobile phone to try and become an expert who can defeat all her enemies in a game.
{character:"Ryuushi"}This is too much! Is this really a beginner match?!
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}Is this why you aren't participating in club activities? Why have you suddenly become addicted to playing games?
{character:"Ryuushi"}Don't you know? The school announced a new gaming competition last week.
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}I did hear my classmates talk about it, but... what's that have to do with you?
The girl pulls out a promotional poster of the gaming competition from the drawer and points at a line of words on it, indicating that "Sora" take a closer look at it.
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}The first prize is... a lab access card?!
{character:"Ryuushi"}To people like us who are crazy about doing experiments, this is the best reward ever! When I win first place, I'm definitely going to send a Catchat message to celebrate!
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}Let me see. 0-13-2... What place did you say you were going to take before you would send that Catchat message?
{character:"Ryuushi"}Hey! How can you say something that cold when your mouth has a temperature of 36°C? I've been practicing really hard, but my hands seem to have a mind of their own.
As if to prove her point, the girl raises her hands and wiggles them to the left and right.
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}Do you really want to win this prize?
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}Haha! You don't really need to make such a big sacrifice. I've got a better way to help you.
{character:player}Huh?
{character:"Ryuushi"}Huh?
As expected, the game offers two options again. Sora and I look at each other with some uncertainty and confusion.
{character:Delinquent B}I'm tight on money recently, so lend me your pocket money! Hahahahaha!
{character:player}I see, so this means a "dude in distress" scene is coming up.
{character:player}Come on, the game just started. It's too early to say something like that. Let's talk to the heroine. She looks really impatient already.
{character:???}Yeah! I need to go home too. Any later and my mom will start to worry about me. Bye! We'll meet again if we are destined to!
{character:"Ryuushi"}Of course it has something to do with me!
{character:"Ryuushi"}That's right! With this access card, we can use the physics lab whenever we want to while we're at university, and there's no time restriction!
{character:"Ryuushi"}Of course! I'll do anything to get it.
Invite her to team up
Win the competition for her
I see Sora moving the joystick to choose the second option, so I stop him quickly.
{character:player}Sora, I think you should choose: "Invite her to team up" here.

{character:Sora Ichinose}*Coughs* But... according to the hint given earlier in the game, I'll get 1 heart of Affinity if I win the prize and give it to her, while I'll only get half a heart if I choose to team up with her.
{character:Sora Ichinose}A happy ending is guaranteed once you get five hearts, so wouldn't it be the better option to not team up in this case?
Before Sora finishes writing the last number, I grab his hand gently and take the gel-ink pen from him.
{character:player}To help you understand, I think I'll put these things away for now.
{character:Sora Ichinose}Huh? But I haven't finished making my calculations.
{character:player}It's very easy to choose the correct answer. Sora, you just need to ask yourself what you would do in that situation.
{character:Sora Ichinose}Ask... myself?
{character:player}Yes. Don't treat this as a game. Treat it like something that is happening in real life and listen to your heart. Maybe that's the best answer you're looking for.
{character:Sora Ichinose}...
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}...
{character:player}...

The afternoon sun shines into the room, dyeing the whole room with a warm color. This kind of warmth is able to reach all the way to the bottom of one's heart and temporarily pulls Sora away from the world of probabilities and calculations.
He lowers his head and considers this question seriously.

{character:Sora Ichinose}*Coughs* If it's with you, {var:player_nickname}... we only have about a 50.70% chance of winning if we team up, the possibility of significantly improving our performance via pre-competition training is not high, and we will probably be eliminated in the preliminary stage...
{character:player}I'm going to interrupt you. I can almost hear a "but" coming up.
{character:Sora Ichinose}*Coughs* But... I'll still choose to team up with you.
{character:Sora Ichinose}It's just that I can't represent everyone. It doesn't mean that the decision to team up is the correct decision.
{character:player}There isn't a perfect formula that can be used to calculate human emotions, and things never develop according to preset plans.
{character:player}Just like when we entered the Halloween fashion show of Dewdrop Middle School. You chose to wear something that wasn't supported by data, but you still managed to get good results.
{character:Sora Ichinose}*Coughs* Is that so...
Under my encouraging gaze, Sora skeptically chose "Invite her to team up."
Before long, it is the day of the preliminary selection, and "Sora" and "Ryuushi" arrive at the venue early to face their opponent.
{character:player}As expected of a romance game. Even the venue of a gaming competition is decorated so romantically. It gives me the feeling of an idol drama.
{character:Sora Ichinose}There seems to be some clipping on the ground in the lower right corner, and all the NPCs freeze when they pass by.
No one is better than Sora when it comes to destroying the atmosphere with a comment.
{character:"Ryuushi"}Help! Help! The opponent's assassin is coming again...
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}There's a healing pack under the tower. Quickly—Urgh, it's too late.

Before "Sora" can finish talking, the hero "Ryuushi" is using has been finished off by the opponent's blade. The scene of her defeat with the "I... I refuse to accept this..." voice line from her character makes her look quite miserable.
*Buzz* A red light turns on, mercilessly announcing the fact that they've been eliminated.
{character:"Ryuushi"}I'm sorry, I dragged you down.
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}You did way better than you usually do during practice.
{character:"Ryuushi"}To thank you for training with me during this time, I'll take you to the amusement park around our campus tomorrow. It'll be my treat! Um... I mean, if you are free.
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}Ahem, of course... I have time.
*Bang* Beautiful fireworks special effects fill the middle of the screen, and the system prompt pops up to tell us that a secret date story has been triggered.
{character:Sora Ichinose}They didn't win any prizes, but the heroine somehow seems even happier... Is it possible that the game has a special stage-clearing algorithm?

{character:player}Haha, this has nothing to do with algorithms. There are no guides that can help us when it comes to emotions, and every piece of interaction is important. Taking this part of the story as an example, we've been training with "Ryuushi" every day, so it's normal for them to develop feelings for each other.
{character:Sora Ichinose}But we didn't provide any actual help. We didn't even pass the first round of the gaming competition.
{character:player}The point here isn't what we end up winning, but who we spend our time with.
You need to explore things for yourself to experience the things that make the romance interesting. I deliberately answer him vaguely to avoid influencing him excessively.
Given Sora's usual personality, I thought he would keep asking me questions about this, but he holds the game thoughtfully for a while before ending this topic himself.
{character:Sora Ichinose}I think I understand a little of what you're saying.

Sora Ichinose picks up his pen and starts to calculate something busily. As the tip of his pen moves, line after line of numbers appear on the paper like a scale that measures people's hearts.//nRational, but cold.
{character:player}Sora, I suggest that you choose "Win the competition for her."

At almost the same time, Sora moves the joystick to select this option. I feel so relieved to see that our tacit communication is good enough that it seems like it has been tested many times in countless drills.
But the facts prove that... wrong samples are useless no matter how many you have.
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}So there you are. I've finally found you.
{character:"Ryuushi"}Hmm? What's up?
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}Ahem, I... I want to give this to you. I remember you really wanted this prize.
The boy takes out the prize he just won and carefully hands it over to her.
{character:"Ryuushi"}Thanks, but... I can't take it.
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}Why? I asked the teacher, and he said...
{character:"Ryuushi"}It's not that. I... I have a few questions to ask you.
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}Go on.
{character:"Ryuushi"}Your roommate's birthday is next week right? Do you know what present he would like?
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}My... roommate?!
{character:"Ryuushi"}Yea, we teamed up for that gaming competition, and he took time to practice with me every day. I want to give him something to thank him.
{character:player}Hold on, can anyone tell me why there's a secondary male character in a romance game?!
{character:Sora Ichinose}It looks like this is part of the twist.

{character:Sora Ichinose}It's so hard to guess what a girl is thinking. Not even the data is one hundred percent accurate. The roommate's Affinity with her is higher than ours, so we need to be very careful with the next decision.
{character:player}True, but I already have a bad feeling about this.

I must say, Sora is a very intelligent boy who is open to other people's opinions. It didn't take him long to immerse himself in the situation to choose the correct option. After experiencing the "damsel in distress" and "through thick and thin" events of the story, his Affinity with "Ryuushi" has risen steadily to four hearts, and it looks like it won't be long before he'll clear the game.

It's the New Year in the game, and "Sora" and "Ryuushi" are meeting together in the commercial strip. These two youths who are celebrating the New Year away from home for the first time have come together, and the fireworks above them create an ambiguous and romantic pink atmosphere around them.

When the "Confess your love now" option pops up on the screen, I take out my phone and get ready to record the moment Sora clears this game for the first time. However, I wait for a long time and watch as he keeps moving the cursor back and forth between the two options without selecting either of them.
{character:player}Sora?
{character:Sora Ichinose}... Um, {var:player_nickname}, what would you choose here?
{character:Sora Ichinose}You see... We've only got four hearts of Affinity here, which means there's a 20.00% chance of failure.
Sora sighs and reaches out habitually on the desk for the pen and paper I put away earlier, as if he wants to further calculate the success rate of the love confession.
{character:Sora Ichinose}I tried the method we used earlier, but... it seems even more difficult here.
{character:player}Eh? Why is that?
{character:Sora Ichinose}Because I care about her, I'm even more afraid of taking risks than usual. I don't want even the slightest risk of losing her.
Sora signs and looks at me for help.
I receive the console and select "Confess your love now" under Sora's surprised gaze.
{character:Sora Ichinose}Why did you choose that? Did you use a different calculation formula?
{character:player}Um... It's my gut instinct.
{character:Sora Ichinose}Are you telling me there's no data to support your decision?

{character:player}"Love" isn't something that numbers can express accurately as there are too many things that can affect it. Time, location, people... Feelings change due to different situations. However, sincerity and bravery will always be the key to success. They can make the impossible become possible and make up for some shortcomings.
{character:Sora Ichinose}But...
Sora lowers his head and thinks for a long time. He thinks for so long that I think he would reject my choice, but I'm overjoyed when Sora presses the OK button in the end.
{character:Sora Ichinose}I still don't understand this problem-solving method, but I'm willing to trust your gut instinct.

After receiving Sora's request for help, I hesitate momentarily but fail to say what is on my heart in the end. To try and max out your Affinity is the most basic way to clear romance games, so I can't say that his choice is wrong.
After seeing my silence, Sora thinks for a long time before he eventually chooses the option to not confess.
Fireworks filled the dark night, scattering sparks everywhere and reflecting people's smiling faces with its fleeting brilliance.
"Sora's" eyes linger on the girl for a long time, but he doesn't say anything in the end and enjoys the splendid fireworks peacefully.
{character:"Ryuushi"}Ichinose, I...
"Boom—" Fireworks bloomed at an inopportune moment, covering "Ryuushi's" words.
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}Huh? What did you say?
{character:"Ryuushi"}You... idiot!
{character:???}What's this? A gentleman must never make a girl angry.
A slender hand passes a tissue to "Ryuushi," and the owner of the hand looks at "Sora" reproachfully.
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}...I don't know what happened. "Ryuushi" just started crying for no reason.
{character:???}Eh, I suggest that you don't say anything right now.
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}?
The girl who had just stopped crying stomps her foot and turns to leave in the darkness, ignoring the confused "Sora."
A bright red dialog box appears. Your Affinity with "Ryuushi" has decreased.
{character:player}Who is this person who suddenly appeared?
{character:Sora Ichinose}He's the protagonist's university roommate. Based on how the events unfold, you can also call him the secondary male character.
{character:player}Hold on, why is there a secondary male character in a romance game?!
{character:Sora Ichinose}This is part of the hidden story. Also, the heroine has quite a high Affinity with him. Hmm... I have a bad feeling about this.
Students wearing academic dresses have gathered here in groups of two and three. They wear smiles on their faces and are laughing happily, filled with the exuberance of youth.
"Sora" is waiting anxiously with a love confession letter in his hands.
{character:"Ryuushi"}Sorry, I'm late.
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}It's okay, I just got here too.
{character:"Ryuushi"}Sora, why did you ask me to come here?
{character:"Sora Ichinose"}I... I want you to have this.
"Sora" hands over an exquisite envelope to the girl and anxiously watches her reaction. The girl freezes for a moment before reacting quickly.
{character:"Ryuushi"}Thank you for feeling this way about me, but I can't take this. I already have someone I like.
Background music starts playing leisurely. The screen becomes colorless for a moment as "Ryuushi" walks past the protagonist and disappears into the background.
Two big words, "Game Over", appear mercilessly on the screen as the previous events are saved.

{character:player}Bad premonitions are always more likely to come true than good ones. Who would have thought that the heroine would gradually alienate us in the subsequent story, that our Affinity with her would keep dropping, and that she would end up with the secondary male character instead.
{character:player}Even though we maxed out all the values, we still failed to win over "Ryuushi." What went wrong?
{character:Sora Ichinose}*Coughs* It seems that this is yet another failure sample.
Compared with me who is feeling annoyed, Sora seems to have accepted this bad ending a lot faster. However, the sad gaze in his eyes exposes his true feelings. He isn't as calm as he appears.
I don't think anyone can keep smiling after dozens of consecutive failures. For Sora, this might be the most difficult puzzle he has encountered so far.
I can't bear to see his disappointed expression any longer, so I pat his shoulder to comfort him.
{character:player}We were so close. If we try again, I'm sure we can clear the game this time.
{character:Sora Ichinose}Yeah.
After selecting "Start Over" with the joystick, Sora and I are brought back to the alley at the very beginning. With our previous experience, we should have no trouble clearing the game this time.
